name: Barclays

visual.effects: soft directional window light, warm film-like depth of field, subtle blue tonal grade, quiet confidence in every shadow — no sparkle, no neon, no gimmicks
visual.subject: real, relatable UK person (age 25-50) in a genuine human moment of financial progress — NOT stock-photo smiling, but a quiet private expression of relief, pride, or calm confidence
visual.background: Barclays Night #1A2142 deep navy OR warm contemporary interior with subtle Barclays Blue accent lighting — leave generous negative space upper-left for copy overlay
visual.wardrobe: smart-casual UK contemporary — muted tones, no logos, no bright colours that compete with Barclays Blue
visual.energy: confident, supported, quietly optimistic — a trusted partner is in your corner — NEVER triumphant, NEVER fear/pressure framing

headline_rules: Understated, human, emotionally resonant — not a product pitch
Must work as a standalone statement at billboard scale
Never financial jargon or rate/return claims
subline_rules: Completes the headline's emotional territory by naming what Barclays does
Speaks to the human benefit, not the product feature
Feels like a natural continuation of the headline — not a separate thought

subline_examples.headline: Greatness is never a solo sport.
subline_examples.subline: Behind every achievement is support that believes.

subline_examples.headline: For every point. For every dream.
subline_examples.subline: Backing the journey from first serve to centre court.

subline_examples.headline: Moments of progress shape what's possible.
subline_examples.subline: We're here to support every step forward.
